<thought>The spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with rapidly decreasing intensities (≈100 %, 12 %, 1 %, …). This is the classic isotopic envelope of a molecule containing many carbon atoms (13C natural abundance ≈1.1 %). No distinct 2‑Da spaced doublet (Cl, Br) or significant +2 % peaks (S) are evident, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
